subject: Unable to connect DataBridge Pro to Connectors
body:
Hi team,

We're experiencing a critical issue with DataBridge Pro. Our Connectors pipeline has been failing since approximately yesterday morning. Error message: 'ERR_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT after 30s'

This is impacting 47 users in our Engineering team. We've tried restarting the service and clearing the cache but the issue persists.

Environment: Production
Version: 3.1.2

Please advise urgently.
